title: 第31章 巴儿姐怀了
novel_title: 丰腴小村妇，大佬们跪求嫁给他(锦绣钱澄)
content_zh: “张国海，你是当事人。赵小义昨天砍了你家院子，你心里就没想过报复？”张国海吓得一哆嗦，差点坐地上，连连摆手。“公安同志，您借我个胆子我也不敢啊！我就这副身板，赵小义一只手就能把我拎起来。我躲他还来不及，哪敢去打他？”“那你有没有指使刘烨去？”“没有！绝对没有！”张国海嗓门都变了调，“他帮我家修院子，我还得管一大盆饭！让他去干犯法的事，一碗饭可能行？人家又不是真傻……”范金花也赶紧搭腔，“是啊，公安同志。我们家永福还瘫在床上呢，全靠我们老两口伺候。我们现在就盼着安稳过日子，哪敢招惹赵家？”公安同志见问不出个所以然，脸上也挂不住了。这深更半夜的，把全村人叫起来，结果是个哑巴案。这时候，年轻公安领着人也来了，他走到老公安旁边，低声说了两句。老公安脸色更黑了，沉思了许久，最后清了清嗓子，声音比刚才更大。“行了，今天问到这里。但是，事情没完！”他目光如炬，扫过底下每一张脸。“赵小义被打，钱被抢，这是刑事案件！我们公安局一定会追查到底。”“我今天把话放这儿，谁要是能提供线索，不管是亲眼看见的，还是听见什么风声的，只要能帮我们抓住人，公安局奖励二十块钱！”二十块！底下嗡的一声，像捅了马蜂窝。一九八五年的二十块钱，那可不是小数目。壮劳力在外面干一天苦力，也就挣个一块多钱。要挣二十块，得干半个月的活。这笔钱，足够让人眼红了。刚才还睡眼惺忪、满脸怨气的村民，这会儿一个个眼睛都亮了。人群里开始窃窃私语。“二十块？真的假的？”“公安同志还能说假话？”“乖乖，这要是让我看见了，我立马就去说。”“你看见啥了？黑灯瞎火的，鬼影子都看不见一个。”徐喜弟的心，咯噔一下沉了下去。她下意识地朝刘烨那边看了一眼。他还是那副憨憨的样子，对周围的议论声充耳不闻。可徐喜弟知道，这二十块钱，就像是悬在刘烨头顶上的一把刀。重赏之下，必有勇夫。村里总有那么几个爱嚼舌根、见钱眼开的。就算没看见，为了这二十块，他们也能给你编出点什么来。“都听清楚了！线索随时可以提供，直接去镇上公安局找我就行！”老公安说完，挥了挥手，“行了，都散了吧！回家睡觉！”人群这才慢慢散开，三五成群地往家走，嘴里讨论的，全是那二十块钱。“咱们快回家吧，这事和咱家一点关系都没有。”范金花转身就往回走，张国海背着手跟在身后。巴儿姐一脸懵，半夜给叫起来，就来广场站了一会儿，又回家。徐喜弟默默跟在他们身后。虽然没说什么话，但她猜想，老两口只怕也认定是刘烨做的。……回到家，堂屋的门刚关上，张国海就爆发了。“看看！看看你干的好事！”他指着徐喜弟的鼻子，声音压得又低又尖，生怕外面的人听见。“我早就说了，拿了钱就了事！你非要去闹！现在好了，事越来越大！你兜得住吗？”“这下还弄出个二十块的奖金来！看你这么收场！”“说，是不是你指使刘烨那傻大个去干的？我可丑话放在前头，要是有人把他检举出来，我张家一概不认！”“你弄出来的好事，你自己承担后果！”范金花也在一旁帮腔，脸色铁青，“真要是刘烨干的，人家也指定要怀疑到咱家头上来？他要是进去了，咱家指定也得跟着倒霉！”徐喜弟默默听完，两手一摊，“谁打赵小义，我还真不知道。我跟烨叔连单独说话都没有，不可能叫他去打人。”“而且，你们老觉得他是傻子，我倒是觉得，他一点都不傻！”傻子，怎么可能夜夜玩出那么多花样来？不，刘烨他一点都不傻，在藏拙！“真不是你指使的？”范金花带着怀疑，又问。“真不是。”徐喜弟回答得很肯定。只要刘烨做得干净，没被人抓到把柄，赵小义这腿就是白白断的。老两口不说话了，转身就进屋睡觉去。……徐喜弟是被堂屋里剁猪菜的声音吵醒的。她睁开眼，巴儿姐还在睡，四仰八叉的。也不知道怎么回事，巴儿姐的衣服扣子，全解开了，大剌剌一片雪白。徐喜弟还是第一次这么直接又全面地观看，总觉得哪里不对。那对大雪子，大得出奇，感觉两只手都包不过一边。她还真用手上去比划了一下，像个五斤的沙田柚那么大。是不是不太正常？忽然，巴儿姐一个转身，侧过来。两个大柚子叠在一起，顶着她的下巴。徐喜弟目光往下移，瞬间脑瓜子嗡嗡响。巴儿姐的肚子，什么时候这么大了？平日穿的衣服，宽宽大大的，因为胸太大，所以肚子从来没有被重视过。里面，该不会怀孩子了吧？想到这个可能，徐喜弟慌忙穿了衣服起床。范金花剁好猪菜正端着进里屋去煮，就被徐喜弟拉住。“妈，巴儿姐上个月，来那个了吗？”范金花被问得一愣，“问这个做什么？她来没来我哪里知道，她会用卫生纸。”“我刚刚才注意，她肚子有点大，不像是胖肉……”“胡说八道……”范金花刚想说什么，又自己顿住了。李二拐说，赵丁已经不止一次脱巴儿姐的裤子，难道怀了？她放下手中的簸箕，匆匆进徐喜弟的屋。看巴儿姐翻着圆肚皮大剌剌躺在床上，她上下打量了好一阵，然后直接上手去按肚子。刚按下去没几秒钟，巴儿姐就醒了，用力拍开她的手。“阿巴巴……”骂骂咧咧坐起来，一边扣衣服扣子，一边翻白眼。虽然没有摸得真切，但范金花心都凉了。巴儿姐下了床，就去后院洗脸，范金花失魂落魄跟在她身后。“你干嘛呢？猪食还煮不煮了？灶里柴火都灭了。”张国海没好气来到她身后。
content_en: "Zhang Guohai, you are the party involved. Zhao Xiaoyi chopped down your yard yesterday, and you never thought about revenge?" Zhang Guohai was so frightened that he almost sat on the ground and waved his hands repeatedly."Comrade Public Security, I don't dare to lend you my courage! With my body like this, Zhao Xiaoyi can pick me up with one hand. How dare I hit him before I can hide from him?" "Then did you instruct Liu Ye to go?" "No! Absolutely not!" Zhang Guohai's voice changed the tone, "He helps my yard to be repaired, and I have to take care of a big pot of rice! Let himHe's going to do something illegal.Isn't he really stupid?" Fan Jinhua also quickly said, "Yes, Comrade Public Security.Our family, Yongfu, is still lying on the bed, relying on our old couple to take care of us.How can we dare to provoke the Zhao family?" Comrade Public Security couldn't figure it out, and he couldn't help it.In the middle of the night, the whole village was woken up, and it turned out to be a mute case.At this time, the young police officer also arrived. He walked up to the old police officer and whispered a few words.The old police officer's face turned darker, he thought for a long time, and finally cleared his throat louder than before."Okay, that's all for today. But, it's not over yet!" He glanced at every face below."Zhao Xiaoyi was beaten and his money was robbed. This is a criminal case! Our Public Security Bureau will definitely pursue it to the end." "I'm putting this here today. If anyone can provide clues, whether they saw it with their own eyes or heard about it, as long as they can help us catch the person, the Public Security Bureau will reward us with twenty yuan!" Twenty yuan!There was a buzzing sound underneath, like a hornet's nest being poked.Twenty yuan in 1985 was no small sum.A strong laborer can only earn more than one yuan by working hard outside for a day.To earn twenty yuan, you have to work for half a month.This amount of money is enough to make people jealous.The eyes of the villagers who were sleepy and full of resentment just now are all bright now.The crowd began to whisper."Twenty dollars? Real or fake?" "How can comrades from the police tell lies?" "Hey, dear, if I see this, I will tell you right away." "What did you see? It was so dark that not even a ghost could be seen." Xu Xidi's heart sank slightly.She subconsciously glanced in Liu Ye's direction.He still looked that naive and turned a deaf ear to the discussions around him.But Xu Xidi knew that these twenty dollars were like a knife hanging over Liu Ye's head.Under heavy rewards, there must be brave men.There are always a few people in the village who love to gossip and are greedy for money.Even if you don't see it, they can make up something for you for these twenty dollars."I heard you all! Clues can be provided at any time. Just go to the town police station to find me!" After the old police officer finished speaking, he waved his hand, "Okay, let's all disperse! Go home and sleep!" The crowd slowly dispersed and walked home in small groups. All they were talking about was the twenty yuan."Let's go home quickly. This matter has nothing to do with our family." Fan Jinhua turned around and walked back, with Zhang Guohai following behind him, his hands behind his back.Sister Ba'er was confused and woke up in the middle of the night. She came to the square and stood for a while, then went home.Xu Xidi followed them silently.Although she didn't say anything, she guessed that the old couple would probably believe that Liu Ye did it....When I got home, as soon as the door of the main room was closed, Zhang Guohai exploded."Look! Look at the good things you have done!" He pointed at Xu Xidi's nose, his voice low and high-pitched, for fear of being heard by people outside."I told you a long time ago, just take the money and the trouble will be over! You have to go and make trouble! It's fine now, the trouble is getting bigger and bigger! Can you handle it?" "Now we even got a bonus of twenty yuan! Look how you ended up!" "Tell me, was it you who instigated it?Is that stupid guy Liu Ye going to do it?I'll put it first.If someone reports him, my Zhang family will not recognize it!" "You have to bear the consequences of the good deeds you do!" Fan Jinhua also spoke up, with a serious look on his face.Qing, "If it's Liu Ye who did it, will people blame our family? If he goes in, our family will also be in trouble!" Xu Xidi listened silently, spreading his hands, "Who hit Zhao Xiaoyi, I really don't know."I didn't even talk to Uncle Ye alone. It's impossible to ask him to hit someone.""Besides, you always think he is a fool, but I think he is not stupid at all!"How can a fool do so many tricks every night?No, Liu Ye is not stupid at all, he is just hiding his clumsiness!"You really didn't instigate it?" Fan Jinhua asked again with suspicion."Really not." Xu Xidi answered firmly.As long as Liu Ye did it cleanly and was not caught, Zhao Xiaoyi's leg would be broken in vain.The old couple stopped talking, turned around and went into the house to sleep....Xu Xidi was awakened by the sound of chopping vegetables and pork in the main room.When she opened her eyes, Sister Ba'er was still sleeping, lying on her back.I don’t know what happened, but all the buttons on Sister Ba’er’s clothes were unbuttoned, and her hair was all white.This was the first time for Xu Xidi to watch it so directly and comprehensively, and he always felt that something was wrong.The pair of big snowflakes were so huge that it felt like they couldn't even be covered with two hands.She actually made a gesture with her hand, and it was as big as a five-pound Shatian pomelo.Isn't it abnormal?Suddenly, Sister Ba'er turned around and came sideways.Two big grapefruits were stacked on top of each other, pressing against her chin.Xu Xidi's eyes moved downwards, and his head was buzzing for a moment.When did Sister Ba'er's belly get so big?The clothes I wear on weekdays are baggy and baggy. Because my breasts are too big, my belly has never been taken seriously.Is she pregnant with a baby inside?Thinking of this possibility, Xu Xidi hurriedly put on his clothes and got up.Fan Jinhua chopped the pork and vegetables and was carrying it into the back room to cook when Xu Xidi grabbed her."Mom, did Sister Ba'er come to that place last month?" Fan Jinhua was stunned when asked, "Why are you asking? How could I know whether she's here or not? She knows how to use toilet paper." "I just noticed that her belly is a bit big. She doesn't look fat..." "Nonsense..." Fan Jinhua was about to say something, but stopped herself.Li Erguai said, Zhao Ding has taken off Sister Ba'er's pants more than once. Could it be that she is pregnant?She put down the dustpan in her hand and hurried into Xu Xidi's house.Seeing Sister Ba'er lying on the bed with her round belly turned over, she looked up and down for a while, and then directly pressed her belly.Just a few seconds after pressing it, Sister Baer woke up and slapped her hand away."Ababa..." He cursed and sat up, buttoning his clothes and rolling his eyes.Although she didn't feel it clearly, Fan Jinhua's heart felt cold.Sister Ba'er got out of bed and went to the backyard to wash her face. Fan Jinhua followed her in despair."What are you doing? Are you ready to cook the pig food? All the firewood in the stove is out." Zhang Guohai came up behind her angrily.
